name: 90802 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90802 (Long Beach) has 201 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90802 (Long Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
